reserved_final_test: 2026 is sealed: no evaluation or selection

coarse_search.method: one-factor-at-a-time around the fixed V1 baseline

refinement.gate: best coarse daily-wallet Sharpe > 0.5 with >= 10 trades

selection: eligible >=10 trades; maximize daily-wallet Sharpe; ties use lower drawdown then canonical config order; cash if no eligible candidate
fold_accounting: reset wallet to 10000 each fold; force-close at each boundary; report both independent folds and geometric linked return (not a continuous engine run)

cost_scenarios.basis: 2024 development only; no selection from OOS cost outcomes

regimes.label_at: last completed daily candle before entry

comparison.interpretation: same capital, interval, 1x contract leverage, taker/slippage assumptions and actual funding; hold has no ATR risk budget and higher exposure, so this is descriptive, not equal-risk ranking

notes: 2024 was inspected in Phase 6; retrospective OOS is not pristine validation.
The full candidate pool uses 2024 development data and must not be applied retroactively to 2024 folds.
Retrospective folds use only the original 12 prespecified coarse candidates; refined candidates are eligible only for 2025 folds.
No 2025 outcomes may change candidate generation, thresholds, selection rule or protocol.
Native engine fees include a slippage cash-cost proxy; execution prices/order books are not replayed.
A one-year OOS and few short trades cannot establish long-term profitability.
